observations: Photo 0 and 1 show a white plastic IBC tank inside a galvanized/grey metal cage with a blue discharge valve at the base, consistent with a standard 1000L IBC tote.
Photo 2 is a close-up of the tank's embossed wall markings, showing partial numbers that read like '1000' and '250 L' calibration marks, but the full capacity/brand plate is not clearly legible.
No close-up of the lid, cap seal, or tank interior is provided.
No visible cracks or active leaks in the frames shown, but the shots are general exterior views, not focused on seams or the base where leaks typically occur.
The cage shows some surface wear/rust typical of used IBC totes; no structural damage visible in the resolution given.

Seller's own description mixes use-cases ('industrial liquids or hazardous chemicals' vs 'food grade, used only once for clean water'), which is ambiguous marketing language rather than a documented history.

identity.kind: 1000L IBC plastic tank (tote) in metal cage

claims.claim: Food grade, used only once for clean water
claims.evidence: No interior shot, residue test, or documentation of prior contents is shown in any photo.
Photos are general exterior views; no close-up of seams, base, or a water-fill/leak test is shown.
Top of tank is not clearly shown in any photo; cap/lid area is cropped out or obscured by the cage in photos 0-2.

risks.risk: Tank may have hairline cracks or seam leaks not visible in static photos
risks.proof: A video of the tank being filled with water or a close-up of the base and seams under pressure
risks.if_unproven: priced as a tank with unverified leak risk, i.e. worst case as potentially leaking

risks.risk: Prior contents could be hazardous/industrial residue despite 'food grade' claim
risks.proof: Photo of the original manufacturer plate/label showing UN rating and prior fill history, or a smell/residue test clip
risks.if_unproven: priced as unknown-history tank, not as certified food-grade

risks.risk: Lid/cap may be missing, cracked, or non-matching
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the top opening and lid threads
risks.if_unproven: priced as if lid is incomplete or compromised

risks.risk: Cage frame could be rusted through or structurally weak at welds
risks.proof: Close-up of cage corners and welds, especially base
risks.if_unproven: priced as cosmetic-only cage, not structurally guaranteed

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the top lid/cap and threading
Video of water being poured in and held to check for leaks at seams and base
Clear photo of the manufacturer/UN rating plate showing capacity and original contents rating
Close-up of cage welds and corners for rust/structural integrity
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable by type as a standard 1000L IBC tote matching the comparable listing, and all seller claims about condition and food-grade history are unverifiable from the photos, so it must be priced at worst case (unverified leak/lid/history) using the available comparable.
